rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Doubt about resurrection should be dispelled because its proof is visible both in human selves and in the surrounding world.
rows.anchor: zira o enfüs ü âfâkta delîlini görüp durduğunuz bir hakikattir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating a living being from inert soil is a greater display of power than reviving the dead, so resurrection is certainly within God's power.
rows.anchor: câmid topraktan bir zîhayat yaratmak, bir ölüyü diriltmekten daha yüksek bir kudret olduğunda şüphe mi edilir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nutfa means semen, more precisely the seed within semen.
rows.anchor: bir nutfeden bir meniden, daha doğrusu menideki tohumdan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alaqa develops after the male nutfa fertilizes the female ovum and is a clotted mass of blood.
rows.anchor: erkek nutfesinin kadın yumurtacığını telkīhinden sonra bir alekadan mütekevvin bir kan totuğundan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mudgha is a morsel of flesh formed from the alaqa, partly with discernible form and partly without it.
rows.anchor: kısmen hilkati belirmiş kısmen de belirmemiş bir çiğnem etten yarattık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These stages make God's power evident and bring people to clear understanding so that they do not doubt.
rows.anchor: kudretimizin beyyinesini izhar edelim, sizi beyâna mazhar eyleyelim de şüphe etmeyesiniz için

words: مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gradual stages each express a distinct form of life and entail a kind of giving life, demonstrating that the Creator can and does revive the dead.
rows.anchor: her biri hayâtın bir sûret-i mahsûsasını ifade ve her mertebesinde bir nevi ihyâyı tazammun eyleyen şu tedrîcî merâtib-i hilkati

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Besides God's power, the embryonic stages also show His will and choice.
rows.anchor: bunlarda kudret delilinden mâ‘adâ bir irade ve meşiyyet delîli bulunduğundan da gaflet etmemelidir

words: وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God keeps whom He wills in the womb until an appointed term: some miscarry, while others remain for the divinely decreed gestation period; this shows His will to give life.
rows.anchor: Bazılarında sıkt vâki‘oluyor, düşüyor da diğer bazıları ezelde takdir olunmuş bir müddet-i haml kadar rahimlerde duruyor

words: ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brings people out as infants and raises them to full strength, intellect, and discernment.
rows.anchor: sonra da eşüddünüze bâliğ olmanız için yani kuvvette, akl ü temyizde kemâlinize ermeniz için büyütürüz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some people die before reaching maturity, after it, or just as they reach it.
rows.anchor: ve sizden kiminiz vefat ettirilir büluğdan sonra veya evvel veya tam o sırada rûhu kabzolunur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others are returned to the most decrepit age, weakened and made helpless by old age.
rows.anchor: kiminiz de ömrün erzeline reddedilir. Gerisin geri kuvvetten düşürülüp kocaltılarak pek düşkün bir hâle getirilir

words: لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elderly may lose knowledge and return toward the weakness and impaired understanding of infancy, approaching their origin in dust.
rows.anchor: bu suretle tufûliyet hâlindeki za‘f u acz ve idraksizliğe doğru dönerek mebde’i olan türâba yaklaşır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All these transformations within human beings prove resurrection through the power and will of the Creator, who can do whatever He wills.
rows.anchor: enfüste olan bütün bu tehavvülât her dilediğini yapmaya kādir olan Hâlık teâlâ’nın kudret ü iradesiyle ba‘sin sıhhatine delâlet eyleyen beyyinâttır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the image first suggests summer land dried by the sun, Elmalılı prefers a literal reading of the earth as burnt ash because it proves the point more clearly.
rows.anchor: bunu teşbih tarîkiyle değil, hakikat üzere anlamak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı explains that earth was once burning fire and that soil is essentially the hardened, deposited ash of an extinguished fire, utterly opposed to life; he says contemporary scientific theories agree.
rows.anchor: toprak esas itibariyle yanıp sönmüş bir ateşin kül hâlinde tesallüb ve teressübüdür

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When water descends, the burnt earth's particles display vital force and begin to vibrate.
rows.anchor: zerrât ve eczâsı kuvve-i hayâtiye ibraz ederek bir hareket-i ihtizâziye ile teprenmekte

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth swells and grows after the water arrives.
rows.anchor: ve kabarıp nemâ bulmakta

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revived earth produces plants of every beautiful kind.
rows.anchor: ve her dilber çiftten nebâtât bitirmektedir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers are those who accepted the revealed clear signs and the required foundations of faith, including divine unity and Muhammad's prophethood; the Yahud remained Jews.
rows.anchor: bu inzal olunan âyât-ı beyyinâta ve mûcebince vahdâniyyet-i ilâhiye ve risâlet-i Muhammediye gibi iman edilmesi lâzım gelen esâsâta iman eylediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here Sabaeans are a narrower group: their placement between Jews and Christians, in the accusative and alongside Magians and polytheists, calls for the more specific sense.
rows.anchor: Ancak burada Sâbiîn Sûre-i Mâide’de

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı compares the Sabaean wording here with its occurrence in al-Maida 5:69.
rows.anchor: Sûre-i Mâide’de إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ [^1] ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ [5/69] bak

words: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Six religious groups are listed; only the first is identified as faithful, so the other five are unbelievers.
rows.anchor: bu âyette altı din zikrolunmuş ve bunlardan yalnız birincisinin ehl-i iman olduğu gösterilmiştir. Demek ki mütebâkī beşi ehl-i küfürdür

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although shirk is stated explicitly only for the last group, the other groups also contain forms of shirk, including the Magians' fire worship.
rows.anchor: Sonra bu beşten yalnız sonuncusunda şirk tasrih edilmiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One possible reading is that the phrase generalizes after specifying earlier groups, meaning the other polytheists as well.
rows.anchor: buradaki وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا ta‘mîm ba‘de’t-tahsîs kabîlinden olarak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı prefers the strict sense of shirk with no claim or interpretation of monotheism mixed in, because it better fits the contrast among the groups.
rows.anchor: burada tasrih olunan şirkten murad hiçbir vechile tevhid iddiası veya

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Christians claim a kind of monotheism by saying that three are one; Magians, especially Zoroastrians, likewise claim to recognize one deity.
rows.anchor: Nasârâ üç birdir diye tevhid iddiasında bulunduğu gibi Mecûs ve ezcümle Zerdüştîler de bir mâbud tanıdıkları iddiasındadır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On this reading the phrase refers to Manichaeans, who profess pure dualism, and idol worshippers, who profess multiple gods.
rows.anchor: mahz-ı sineviyet iddia eden Maneviyye ile abede-i esnâm gibi mahz-ı ta‘addüd iddia eden müşrikleri iş‘âr etmiş olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sabaeans are those who, like Christians, do not openly profess shirk.
rows.anchor: sâbiînden murad da Nasârâ gibi sarâhaten şirk iddiasında bulunmayanlardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question means either that the addressee perceives this with the heart's eye or that he has heard of it.
rows.anchor: görmedin mi yani kalb gözüyle idrak edemedin mi veya haberin yok mu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All things in reality prostrate by submitting completely to God's judgment and governance.
rows.anchor: Hakikatte Allah, O’na hep şunlar secde ediyor

words: مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase includes everything above and below, such as angels and souls, and every living and nonliving thing.
rows.anchor: yukarılarda ve aşağıda her kim ve her ne varsa, melâike ve nüfûs, canlı ve cansız her şey

words: وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The named examples of those subject to God include the sun, moon, stars, mountains, trees, and all animals.
rows.anchor: Şems ü Kamer ve nücûm, dağlar ve ağaçlar ve bütün hayvânât

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Many people means a portion of humanity, not everyone or even necessarily a majority; the portion is still substantial.
rows.anchor: insanlara gelince hepsi değil, ekserîsi de değil, bir kısmı, mukabilinden daha çok değilse de haddizâtında bir kesret teşkil eden bir kısmı secde ediyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All people are included in the earth's inhabitants insofar as they submit involuntarily to God's coercive effects.
rows.anchor: Gerçi Allah teâlâ’nın te’sîrât-ı cebriyesine, bütün insanlar da ister istemez inkıyad eyler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a portion of people, namely believers, freely submit through obedient prostration, which involves the human will.
rows.anchor: ihtiyar ile alâkadar olan inkıyâd-ı irâdîyi ve secde-i itâati yapan insanların ancak bir kısmıdır ki mü’minlerdir

rows.speaker: bazı müfessirîn
rows.claim: Some commentators take the phrase as a new coordinated clause, supplying an implied 'many people prostrate' to emphasize obedient prostration.
rows.anchor: bazı müfessirîn bu secde-i itâat mânasını ibraz için işbu وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ kaydının atf-ı cümle kabîlinden olmak üzere ويسجد كثير من الناس takdîrinde olduğunu söylemişlerdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those deserving punishment rebel against God's command in unbelief and disobedience, refusing obedient prostration; they are devils and their human followers.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın emrine karşı küfr ü isyan ile serkeşlik edip secde-i itâatten istinkâf eylemiştir. Ki bunlar şeytanlar ve şeytanlara uyan insanlardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers subjected to attack by hostile unbelievers were authorized to fight back because they had been wronged.
rows.anchor: hâin kâfirler tarafından kıtâle maruz kalan mü’minler onlara karşı harb u kıtâle mezun kılındılar

rows.speaker: Resûlullah
rows.claim: The Companions came to the Prophet beaten or wounded by polytheists to complain, and he told them to be patient because fighting had not yet been commanded.
rows.anchor: Ashâb kimi darp olunmuş kimi yaralanmış bir hâlde gelirler, Aleyhissalâtü vesselâm’a tezallüm ederlerdi. “Sabrediniz, çünkü kıtal ile emrolunmadım” buyururlardı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the migration, this verse was revealed as the first revelation concerning fighting.
rows.anchor: nihâyet hicret ettiler bu âyet nâzil oldu ki kıtal hakkında ilk nâzil olan âyettir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı points to al-Baqara 2:190, which commands fighting in God's path against those who fight the believers.
rows.anchor: Sûre-i Bakara’da [^3] وَقَٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ bak [2/190]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is fully able to grant the believers victory, so they should not doubt their ability to fight despite being few against many unbelievers.
rows.anchor: kâfirler çok, mü’minler az nasıl mukātele edebilirler gibi şüpheye düşmemelidir

words: أُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wronged believers were expelled from their property and homes without just cause except that they said their Lord is Allah.
rows.anchor: أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God repels aggressive oppressors, corrupters, and unbelievers through just people, the righteous, and believers.
rows.anchor: mütecâviz zâlimleri, müfsidleri, kâfirleri âdillerle, sâlihlerle, mü’minlerle def‘etmesi olmasa idi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sawami originally means a tall, pointed building, used before Islam for Christian monks' monasteries and Sabaean ascetics' retreats, and later for Muslim minarets; here it means the monasteries or retreats.
rows.anchor: “Savma‘a” esasen tepesi sivri mürtefi‘binâ demektir ki İslâm’dan evvel Nasârâ râhiplerinin manastırlarına

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Biya refers to churches, the places of worship of Christians.
rows.anchor: “Bî‘a” Nasârâ ibadethânesi olan kilise demektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Salawat here is the Arabicized Hebrew saluta and means Jewish prayer houses, or synagogues.
rows.anchor: “Salât” burada İbrânice “saluta” mu‘arrebidir ki Yahudîlerin namazgâhı, yani havra demektir

words: مَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Describing mosques as places where God's name is often mentioned both states frequent remembrance as Islam's primary worship aim and signals that other institutions have departed from their original purpose of remembrance.
rows.anchor: Birisi İslâm ibadetinde ismullâhın çok zikredilmesi maksûd-ı aslî olduğunu tasrih, ikincisi de diğerlerinin vaz‘-ı aslî olan zikrullahtan udûl ile başka maksatlarda isti‘mâl olunduğuna işarettir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without God moving religious people to repel aggressors and authorizing believers to fight, all these sanctuaries would be destroyed; irreligious attackers would spare none.
rows.anchor: ehl-i imana harp hakk u salâhiyeti vermese idi manastırlar ve zâviyeler, kiliseler ve havralar ve içinde Allah ismi kesîren zikredilen mescidler bütün hedm olunurdu; dinsizlerin taarruzu hiçbirini bırakmaz

words: لَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı links the destruction prevented by repelling aggressors to the corruption of the earth mentioned in al-Baqara.
rows.anchor: Sûre-i Bakara’da geçtiği üzere Arz fâsid olurdu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preservation and safety of the religious institutions is proportionate to their defense, so Islam's right of defense is all the more established.
rows.anchor: ve selâmeti müdafaalarıyla mütenâsibdir. O hâlde bütün bunların himâyesini istihdaf eden İslâm’ın hakk-ı müdafaası evleviyetle sâbittir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aiding God means aiding His religion.
rows.anchor: Allah’a nusret dinine nusret demektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because religion concerns voluntary acts, the realization of divine will in this matter is contingent on the servant's partial will; human effort becomes a means to divine accomplishment, hence is called aid.
rows.anchor: din ef‘âl-i ihtiyâriyeye ta‘alluk ettiği cihetle ol babda maksûdun husûlü için irâde-i ilâhiyenin ta‘alluku abdin irâde-i cüz’iyesine mu‘allak olduğundan kulların irâde-i cüz’iyelerini sarf ile sa‘yleri irâde-i ilâhiyenin incâzına vesile olmak itibariyle bir nusret gibidir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes the certainty of victory depend on believers' aid, meaning their effort.
rows.anchor: nusretinin kat‘î tahakkukunu onların nusretine, yani çalışmalarına rabt eylemiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is strong and mighty and needs no aid; those He aids are honored and cannot be overcome.
rows.anchor: Nusrete ihtiyâcı yoktur. Ve nusret ettiği muazzez ve gayr-i mağlubdur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Empowerment in the land means bringing them to a position of authority and enabling them to govern.
rows.anchor: Biz onları Arzda temkin edersek yani makām-ı iktidâra getirir, icrâ-yı hükûmet ettirirsek

words: أَقَامُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ ٱلْمُنْكَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When empowered, they establish prayer, give zakat, command what is recognized as good, and forbid what is unlawful, ugly, and rejected.
rows.anchor: meşrû, müstahsen tanınacak şeylerle emir; nâmeşru, çirkin, merdud şeylerden nehyederler

words: أَقَامُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ ٱلْمُنْكَرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who reach power should not corrupt their character or depart from religion and justice; the Rightly Guided Caliphs exemplified this.
rows.anchor: Mevki‘-i iktidâra geçince ahlâklarını bozmaz, dinden, adaletten inhiraf etmez evliyâ-yı umûr olurlar. Fi’l-hakīka hulefâ-i râşidîn böyle olmuşlardı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ultimate outcome of all affairs belongs to God.
rows.anchor: Fi’l-hakīka hulefâ-i râşidîn böyle olmuşlardı. Ma‘amâfîh {وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ}dur.
